linux_prevalidation_followup.scope: Concrete remaining failures from the first real 100-task Linux run; excludes shared runtime copy collisions and missing-pytest interpreter construction issue. No original acceptance definition is changed.

diagnosis_and_environment_repair.action: Create the source-declared console entrypoint in the per-task venv bin, using that task interpreter and workspace import path. Do not install a different glom implementation.
Restore source-declared CLI and include printenv. Original sh invocation also requires real PTY support; package changes alone cannot supply it. Do not monkeypatch sh or delete/relax tests.

diagnosis_and_environment_repair.actual_family_widening_bug: cpu_stage.py regex captured only major.minor, causing 3.11 to select a newer patch release.
diagnosis_and_environment_repair.action: Rebuild the task environment with Python 3.11.8; use major.minor only for lib/python3.11/site-packages directory naming.
